Done! ✓ Your `.env` file will now load automatically in every PowerShell session.

**What was set up:**
- **Profile location:** `/home/author\Documents\PowerShell\profile.ps1`
- **Behavior:** When you open any PowerShell terminal, it checks for a `.env` file in the current directory and automatically sets all environment variables from it
- **Verified:** All 5 variables from your `.env` file (API_BASE_URL, API_KEY, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, NPM_TOKEN) are loading correctly

This works for both PowerShell and PowerShell ISE, and persists across all future sessions on this machine.
